events.title: ERC-8004 created
events.detail: Trustless Agents, Standards Track ERC, status Draft.

events.title: First merged into ethereum/ERCs
events.detail: Pull request 1170.

events.title: Moved to Review; contracts repository created
events.detail: Erik Reppel added as author.

events.title: First testnet registries listed
events.detail: Testnets listed from 2025-10-22 to 2025-11-03, with Validation Registry addresses.

events.title: feedbackAuth removed from the contracts
events.detail: Tags become strings; contract version 1.1.0.

events.title: Trustless Agent Day in Buenos Aires
events.detail: A Devconnect event at La Rural; entry required a Devconnect ticket.

events.title: Testnet Validation addresses dropped from the README
Spec drops feedbackAuth and adds setAgentWallet
events.detail: Reserved agentWallet key, x402Support and active fields.

events.title: Returned from Review to Draft by an EIP editor
endpoints renamed services; score replaced by value and valueDecimals
events.detail: Last change to the text as of 2026-10-18.

events.title: Ethereum mainnet registries listed
events.detail: Identity and Reputation registries only.

events.title: Polygon listed as the second mainnet
events.detail: Base, Monad and BSC followed on 2026-02-03.

events.title: Sixteen mainnets listed
events.detail: Scroll and Gnosis on 2026-02-04; Arbitrum, Celo and Taiko on 2026-02-05; Linea, MegaETH, Optimism and Avalanche on 2026-02-10; Abstract and Mantle, marked work in progress, on 2026-02-12.

events.title: Five more mainnets listed, 21 in all
events.detail: GOAT Network, Metis, SKALE Base, Soneium and XLayer; Mantle loses its work-in-progress label.

events.title: ERC-8226 Regulated Agent Mandate created
events.detail: Names ERC-8004 as an example agent identity registry; the mandate layer works with any agent identity system.

events.title: The Graph announces Agent0 subgraphs live on five chains
ERC-8126 reaches Final while ERC-8004 stays Draft
Empirical study arXiv:2606.26028 published
events.detail: Liveness 3% to 15%; majority Sybil reviewers.

events.title: Robinhood Chain listed as the 25th mainnet
CSOAI census of 505,635 agent ids
Single externally owned account owns the proxies on Ethereum and Base
events.detail: Holder not published.

events.title: Central City batch registrations on Base
events.detail: Base's highest agentId rose from 243,865 (2026-10-19) to 1,122,121 (2026-10-24), read on chain. Every sampled id in the wave points to centralcity.ai.

events.title: ERC-8217 rewritten
events.detail: The Draft companion now binds an ERC-8004 agent to a token, an account or a contract, requires ERC-7930 and adds bindingHashOf, a 32-byte Universal Binding Identifier.

events.title: Second batch wave on the unlisted Arc Mainnet
events.detail: Arc's highest agentId rose from 2,913 (2026-11-01) to 404,662 (2026-11-07), again from Central City (on-chain reads). On 2026-11-14 8004scan counted 2,062,896 agents by its own method, while 0G, which it does not index, held about 3.94 million more ids.

events.title: Third Central City wave, on Optimism
events.detail: Optimism's highest agentId rose from 780 (2026-11-14T00:00Z) to 22,083 (2026-11-16T00:00Z), read on chain, and sampled ids point to Central City. On 2026-11-21 8004scan counted 2,137,737 agents by its own method.

events.title: mppx 0.20.0 adds an ERC-8004 agent identity provider
events.detail: MPP's reference SDK can check that the wallet the Identity Registry names for an agent (on Tempo mainnet by default) signed a request or a tempo charge. It is an SDK feature, not part of ERC-8004 or of an MPP draft.

events.title: ERC-8048 and ERC-8049 keep agent profile keys on-chain only
events.detail: The Draft metadata standards now keep their agent keys (context, endpoints, addresses and accounts) out of tokenURI and contractURI JSON, because JSON can change without an on-chain event. ERC-8048's profile already described its web endpoint type as aligned with ERC-8004.

events.title: Owner account upgrades the Neo X registries to 2.0.0
events.detail: The registry owner account 0x547289319C3e6aedB179C0b8e8aF0B5ACd062603 moved all three Neo X proxies off the 1.0.0 placeholder. A pull request to list Neo X in the README was still open on 2026-11-21, and no agent was registered there.

events.title: ERC-8226 rewritten to scope mandates by target contract
events.detail: PR #2191 keys a mandate by agent, principal and target and replaces the single per-asset caps with allowed actions, calldata constraints and per-asset outflow and inflow limits. ERC-8226 is still Draft.
